dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there something special about mushrooms from Sumeru?

dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: Oh... I'm not really the right person to ask. I'm no expert in plants.

dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: They don't look much different on the outside... Maybe they have a unique taste or something?

dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: How about this: You take this one back with you and put it in your next dish. If the dish turns out well, put in a good word for me with all your acquaintances! Hahaha...
